record.question:
Consider the following statements about three new farm laws.
1. Farmers' Produce Trade and Commerce (Promotion and Facilitation) Act, 2020 permits intra and inter-state trade of farmers' produce beyond the physical premises of APMC markets.
2. Essential Commodities (Amendment) Act, 2020 will set stockholding limit for private players for all agricultural commodities to prevent black-marketing.
3. Farmers (Empowerment & Protection) Agreement on Price Assurance and Farm Services Act, 2020 will facilitate contract farming.
Which statement (s) is/are correct
